Name: Pokemon Valley - Digspot
Author: Parme69
Description:
Change the worms indicating the artifact locations to dig at, and replace them with Digletts or Poké Balls.
You can choose one Seed digspot option and one Artifact digspot option, or randomize (it will change each day).
